name: agent-recorder-bootstrap
description: Connect an external Recorder 0.1.25 portable package and request a silent 1-30 second selected-region MP4 with local selection and approval. Query the original operation without resubmitting unknown outcomes.

interface.longDescription: Bind an external Windows x64 Recorder 0.1.25 package, request a short silent selected-region recording with local approval, query its MP4 result, or explicitly stop its exact mapped recording ID. No sound, window, plan, global stop or deletion tools.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me connect my Recorder portable package.
